name: m27-delivery-failure-bypasses-window
rationale: 投递失败分支绕过放弃窗（只有读不到才判超窗）→ 毒条目 attempts 无限增长、永远 pending
old:
over_window = (
                attempts >= QUARANTINE_MAX_ATTEMPTS
                or (now - first_seen) >= QUARANTINE_ABANDON_SECONDS
            )
new:
over_window = (event is None and (
                attempts >= QUARANTINE_MAX_ATTEMPTS
                or (now - first_seen) >= QUARANTINE_ABANDON_SECONDS
            ))
